about_the_game:
Exoshock is a 1-4 cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter built VR-first from the ground up, featuring intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields!

Designed as a VR-native experience, Exoshock also includes non-VR (flat) support from day one, allowing VR and non-VR players to team up together through full cross-play.

INTO THE FIRE

The dropship doors slam open. Gunfire erupts as your squad breaches the hostile warzone. Tactical coordination and split-second decisions mean survival or annihilation.

ADAPT YOUR PLAYSTYLE

Customize your loadout, refine your tactics, and coordinate with teammates. Whether leading assaults, supporting allies, or adapting on the fly, Exoshock lets you shape your combat experience.

EVER-CHANGING WARZONES

Investigate a derelict warship overrun with Ravagers or pivot when defenders disable life support mid-mission. With adaptive AI and evolving gameplay, no two missions play the same.

IMMERSIVE, CINEMATIC WARFARE

Gunfire illuminates the darkness, sparks spray from ricochets, and klaxons blare. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, Exoshock delivers next-level combat intensity.

FEATURES BUILT FOR REPLAYABILITY

  • Face adaptive AI that counters your tactics.

  • Engage in intense 1-4 player co-op firefights.

  • Customize loadouts to suit your style.

  • Battle through unpredictable environments.

  • Adjust strategies between aggression and precision.

  • Evolve with player-driven updates.

Your mission is set. Your squad is waiting. Will you step into the fire—or be lost to the void?

If you haven't already, make sure to join our Official Exoshock Discord.

This is the best place to stay updated in real-time and get more information!

content_descriptors.notes: Futuristic gun violence in a gritty dystopian setting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7‐4790K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7‐9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
